narrative.details: I will get started immediately on crafting your orb and infusing your new demon into it. When done, you will have the choice of having it in the form of a staff or orb. I always felt it was important to cater to a warlock's chosen weapon... I see no reason not to continue that practice.
narrative.objectives: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It is done, adventurer. Simply tell me which you'd prefer: a staff that would require you to use both hands, or an orb so you may use a dagger or sword as your weapon.

Tackling a felhound was a great feat on your part. I am sure your item will serve you well in the future. Continue to work hard in the arts, adventurer. I will be awaiting details of your exploits.
narrative.endText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your item

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 35 to 40, 12,300 XP in all.

quests.name: Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Menara's acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet and choose one of their paths to follow. Afterwards, bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
quests.objectiveText: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
quests.objectiveText: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.
